name: Omega Leads
old_description: Cable assembly and custom wire harness manufacturer, 55+ years
about:
Omega Leads, founded in 1971, is a privately owned and operated cable assembly and wire harness manufacturer based in Santa Monica, California. The company began as a supplier to OEMs and manufacturers across multiple industries and has remained a domestic producer for over five decades.

The company produces custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and related wire processing services using computer-controlled robotic equipment. Capabilities include wire cutting, stripping, crimping, termination, identification, labeling, and electrical testing. Omega Leads offers turnkey solutions with in-house application engineering, prototyping, and first-article inspection, building products to IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards under an ISO-compliant quality system.

Omega Leads serves medical, aerospace, automotive, military, electronic, lighting, and solar industries. Its customers include OEMs and manufacturers requiring custom interconnect solutions for demanding applications such as medical devices, aerospace wire harnesses, automotive wiring, and military equipment.

The company emphasizes domestic manufacturing, consistent communication, and the use of high-quality materials from major connector suppliers such as Molex, TE Connectivity, and Deutsch. Its differentiators include decades of experience, competitive pricing, and a full-service approach from design through production.
